verdict.rationale: Fin's plan list names AI Topics, Trends, Monitors and Incident Detection, which map directly to topic clustering and surfacing emerging issues. Insights is described as continuously analyzing every Fin and human conversation, alongside Monitors and Recommendations. The evidence is only feature-list-level marketing copy, so 'full' rests on named capabilities rather than documented behavior. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how AI Topics clusters conversations, evidence that Trends/Incident Detection flags issues early before volume spikes, alerting details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
